reviews.text: I couldn't be happier with our experience training our dog! The trainer was truly exceptional — patient, knowledgeable, and completely dedicated. His calm and consistent approach made a huge difference, and our dog has shown incredible progress. From struggling with basic commands, we now enjoy confident walks and a well-behaved dog. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for real results with a professional who cares!

For me, Think Dog represents a true ecosystem, a meeting place where everyone—from dog trainers to novices, from those seeking support for their dog to academics and enthusiasts—can engage in constructive dialogue, with the common goal of promoting holistic animal welfare.

For those wishing to undertake a training program, I highly recommend the dog trainer course (I personally attended it at the Rome office). It offers excellent training, solid theoretical and technical skills, and ongoing support from teachers, tutors, and the entire staff, facilitating profound experiences of connecting and communicating with dogs.

It's much more than a dog training school: it's a life journey that can make you a better person. Learning to think like a dog, learning to connect with his world, is one of the most beautiful and exciting experiences I've ever had.

I trained at Thinkdog as a dog trainer in behavioral rehabilitation and socialization classes, and I can say it was a rewarding experience, both educationally and personally. The knowledge I gained from the expert instructors on the course continues to be of great help to me in my daily work at the shelter and with my clients. Furthermore, the collaborative atmosphere in which the lessons are conducted, the desire to network among professionals, and the desire to leave no one behind but instead help one another, are perfectly consistent with the principles on which the school is founded.

★★★★★
As a dog trainer with years of experience, I've always searched for a school that goes beyond traditional training, one that captures the true essence of the bond between humans and dogs. With Thinkdog, I've finally found my professional and spiritual home. Their philosophy, a true "think like a dog," isn't just a method, but a profound and mystical approach that recognizes the complex minds and rich emotional lives of our four-legged companions.
Thinkdog embodies the "New Dog Training," based on kindness, non-coercion, and the firm belief that relationships are the foundation of every shared growth journey. It's here that I've seen people and dogs evolve together, in a process of authentic and profound connection. I'm thrilled to be part of this community that not only trains excellent professionals, but guides us to rediscover ourselves through the wonderful world of animals. Thinkdog isn't just a school, it's a lifestyle that enriches and transforms.

I'm still in training, and will complete the dog trainer course in April 2026. I've been fascinated by the course since the first session, and I'm thrilled. First, because of the classroom atmosphere, which the teachers and tutors foster with specific activities and truly commendable attention and care. Second, because the theoretical content is incredibly interesting, and we're constantly encouraged to study and reflect. Finally, because the practical and supporting activities (homework, TDcamp) are designed to allow us to immediately get hands-on with our dogs, our colleagues, and the pairs who volunteer to do activities with us. It's certainly a journey that requires commitment to be successful and effective, but everything about it makes it easy. I must say that the course marked a turning point in my relationship with my dog ​​Piuma (and not that she was a bad dog before!!!), and all the experiences I've had with her through the course have been incredibly enriching! Highly recommended!

During my training on the dog training course, I found a very well-organized environment and teaching methods led by qualified, experienced, and helpful instructors. It's an exceptional program that opens minds and hearts, providing new insights. I'm in the midst of an incredible journey that I highly recommend, even to those who, like me, don't have a dog by their side at this point in their lives. If I could do it again, I'd sign up again.

I earned my diploma as a dog trainer and instructor in canine sociability and freedom at ThinkDog, and my experience at this school had a profound impact on me, helping me better understand dogs and gain a broader and more inclusive perspective that encompasses the entire network of relationships between living beings.
At ThinkDog, teaching combines a scientific and ethological approach to build a solid foundation of knowledge with a profound focus on empathy and compassion, essential elements for creating a harmonious and respectful relationship with dogs and for understanding their needs and behaviors.
I cannot but highlight the solidity of the organization, made up of highly trained teachers, tutors, and assistants who are attentive and committed to providing all the necessary support, the quality of the teaching, and the school's dedication to providing tools and knowledge to grow and improve relationships with dogs, with a good balance of theoretical lessons and hands-on practice.
In addition to the online and in-person lessons, you can participate in events organized by the school's tutors and educators/instructors to refine your technique and learn more.
General availability is truly a strong point of ThinkDog throughout the training process and beyond. The school also maintains a strong relationship with its students even after the end of the courses and graduation, and I find this a great opportunity for discussion and continuous growth for any individual or professional.
To sum up, what words come to mind when I think of ThinkDog? Ethics, preparation, competence, serenity, kindness, availability, discussion, and an enlightened vision.
Beautiful experience, fantastic approach and way of education!

A way of thinking, a place for meeting, discussion, and collaboration among colleagues and others. This is ThinkDog, as well as a highly effective training school. In addition to its technical dog training skills, it provides a healthy environment where you can test yourself as a person, with people. A cognitive-relational approach and more; be wary of those who spitefully spout nonsense based on hearsay. You'll improve along with the dogs you spend time with!

ThinkDog is a special place! Each course offered is designed, refined, and structured to ensure each participant has access to ongoing developments in the field of dog training, using a cognitive-relational approach. The teaching staff, tutors, the school director, and the entire staff are always ready to help, listen, and make participants feel at ease throughout the training program and beyond. The needs of the class are always carefully considered, and solutions are quickly found to support learning, both in person and online.
The many in-depth programs, such as the Master's programs, are supplemented each year by top-notch instructors. At the end of each module, you can't wait to attend the next one, and while you wait, you carry deep emotions and incredible knowledge with you. Thanks to this school, my life has changed, rediscovering important and authentic values ​​with the world!

Knowledge and training are the most important words that convinced me to join the Thinkdog world.
I took the first step at another school, but I felt something was missing... the total connection with the dog 🐶
I found a world to discover, where you feel part of the group, with the group, not just of students but of teachers, tutors, and assistants who make the difference 🧡❤️
ThinkDog training is a complete and unique experience, just like each of our travel and life companions, dogs.
Certainly a shining light in the dog training world, I believe it to be the most up-to-date school in Italy. If you're not satisfied with the concept of a trainer, this is the right school for you.

My encounter with the Think Dog school took place one dramatic night when, at 2 a.m., in tears and despair, I wondered how to help my wonderful dog overcome his fear.
We had been attending a wonderful training and relationship program for about eight months, with lots of games, exercises, luring, and treats. My dog ​​was already almost nine years old, a giant among the puppies. The place was wonderful: trees, flowers, huge fields, and excellent trainers who let Roy do his thing. He was actually very good; he understood immediately, had perfect lines, and executed perfectly. I also discovered a world of satisfaction. At home, we did a lot of work, exercises, and so on... But my dog ​​remained afraid. He moved with fear, acting only out of fear.
He still wouldn't get out of the car, staying under the table or on the couch.
We weren't solving anything!
When I realized this, I broke down. It was like seeing him for the first time. I cried in despair and started searching online. I found a video by Angelo Vaira about fear, then another, then another... I had found the answer to my questions!
I stopped crying, I searched for tons of videos. Early that morning, I sent an email to one of their trainers/instructors, an expert in rehabilitation, the wonderful Marina Balbi. Her CV said she was now dedicated to introductions. I sent it anyway.
That morning, I found a few words: "Call me at lunchtime, we'll talk about it."
A wonderful rehabilitation process began, constant, daily, as she guided me into the mysteries of the dog's mind, relationships, guidance, support.
I had to look inside myself several times as Roy and I became more and more connected.
After two years, I signed up for the dog trainer course. I knew Roy wouldn't be able to attend, but another adorable and terrifying Cana arrived.
I don't know all the courses out there, but I did my research.
The Think Dog course is explained very clearly and in detail; when I took it, they even required a sort of application, a form to fill out to be accepted.
Then there's a free online information meeting where the instructors introduce themselves and briefly outline the course, its philosophy, and its objectives.
From the start until the end, you're constantly supported, monitored, and assisted by tutors and managers.
It creates a strong team spirit, collaboration, and sense of unity.
Many modules were taught online, with excellent organization, both theoretical and practical, and many were taught in person, with entire weekends spent on the computer and just as many in the field.
Finally, before the exams, things get more difficult. The obstacles you face may make you want to give up, but there you reveal who you really are: your desire, your determination, your commitment, your ability to structure your work, find clients, maintain relationships, carry them forward despite all the variables, resolve issues with their dogs...
If you've passed everything, you get to the exam, the longest, most interminable day where you have to manage a thousand things: your dog, his and your balance, focus, emotional state, needs, meals, all the notions that now course through your veins, the technical terms that bounce from one neuron to another...
And then, when it's all over, you're immensely happy... and you'll miss it 😃 😃

At ThinkDog, I found the key I'd been looking for for a long time: the cognitive-relational approach followed by the school allows for profound transformation in the relationship with dogs and beyond. When we commit to connecting with ourselves and then with other living beings, communication becomes more authentic, respectful, and effective. The relationship with dogs changes, but so does our perception of people and the world. Kindness, acceptance, knowledge, openness, professionalism: these are the words that best describe ThinkDog and its staff of teachers, tutors, and assistants. I'm enthusiastic about the tools the school is providing me, which I'm slowly learning and using. What I've undertaken at ThinkDog is a wonderful journey for which I will always be grateful.

Before discovering the ThinkDog school, I encountered "trainers" who suggested behaviors for my dog ​​that I wasn't convinced by because they didn't leave me feeling comfortable. I searched extensively and researched online, to the point that I decided, in 2023, to enroll in the ThinkDog Educators Course. To those who have asked and will ask me if it's a good school, I have always said that I wholeheartedly recommend it. I would enroll 1,000 times over, because it's not just a school for educators and instructors: it's a 360° School of Life. In addition to the technical, theoretical, and practical skills (based on all the latest scientific studies) it imparts, it is founded on listening, collaboration, non-judgment, encouragement, respect, and trust toward both humans and dogs. It teaches how to observe, reflect, be proactive and positive, embrace diversity as unique, and work as a team. Angelo Vaira, the entire faculty, and the entire staff are dedicated professionals, highly competent, and always available. Listening to students' comments online, I wondered how a course could change your life: it really does! You change inside, profoundly! And after the exam, you stay connected, you can always stay up to date. You're never alone. You continue to grow together.

I discovered ThinkDog during my training journey through Angelo's book "Straight to the Heart of Your Dog" and the live broadcasts he gave during the Covid period.

I was already a dog trainer and had already attended an instructor course, but I wanted more. So I decided to enroll and made several trips to Milan to take the lessons with my dogs Amy and Derek.

Starting from the premise that training is and will be ongoing, the course gave me additional skills to bring to my work, but not only that.

The Socialization Classes opened up a world to me, which remains exciting and thrilling to this day.

What sets this training school apart, however, is not only the approach that takes into account the subjective and unique nature of the dog, who lives and thrives on relationships, but also the way in which these relationships become the strengths of the training. Collaboration, discussion, and ultimately, yes, even friendship.

Living with the dog here (like for me) is a lifestyle.

This school is unique for everything it can teach; it's a program that synergistically combines many teachings, not just those that form the basis of dog training. It's a tremendous stimulus for a shift in perspective and an inner transformation that brings unparalleled enrichment.

Thanks to Angelo and his invaluable advice shared on social media, I was able to salvage my relationship with Mike, which had seemed irreparable. This encouraged me to delve deeper into the program and get to know the entire team better: tutors, teachers, and assistants, all truly extraordinary, both personally and professionally. My classmates were also a wonderful surprise: special, welcoming, and authentic. Finally, I want to emphasize how crucial the blended learning experience (online and in-person) was: for someone like me who lives in Sardinia, it represented a real opportunity. Without this formula, participating would have been practically impossible. I am deeply grateful for this experience: it has given me, and continues to give me, tools, relationships, and newfound confidence.

I've been wanting to enroll in the dog training program at this school for years, and I finally did, and I couldn't have made a better choice. The level of preparation of the entire faculty and tutors is unparalleled, and the love and respect for dogs (and animals in general) is at the heart of everything at this school. Finding such fantastic classmates to share this journey with was the icing on the cake! Thank you, ThinkDog.

I feel very fortunate and deeply grateful for my journey at Think Dog.
It's not just a course for educators; it offers tools and opportunities for growth and transformation for us and our beloved four-legged friends, allowing us to express the best of ourselves. It creates the foundation for a more conscious and aware vision.

Good morning,
I would like to express my appreciation for the Thinkdog school, where I trained as a dog trainer.
Over time, I have continued to update my knowledge by attending courses, seminars, and webinars. The offerings are varied, in-depth, scientifically based, and always cutting-edge. One of the unique features of the approach is its focus on the comprehensive training and growth of those who attend, promoting their development and enhancing their skills.
Top-notch organization and staff.
Competence, professionalism, absolutely positive experience!

My experience with the educators course was a turning point in my relationship with my dogs... it helped me a lot to understand them and know how to manage them. I changed my perspective of vision... the course is not just a simple course but something that goes deep, I found a family and many colleagues-friends who think like me and who will accompany me for the rest of my life ♥️. As for me, I recommend it to everyone. A staff that never abandons you even after the exam💪🏻

ThinkDog isn't just a school of excellence. ThinkDog is a place where competition gives way to sharing, where arrogance blushes and fades away. ThinkDog is a place where the journey is first and foremost a personal growth project. You learn to read dogs and, through them, to get to know yourself, your colleagues, and your clients. Judgment then gives way to empathy, sharing, collaboration, but also to respectful dialogue with everyone. It's a great school of life, where seriousness and fairness towards all living beings are the magical ingredients—sought after, desired, and practiced. The instructors are ALL highly qualified and industry professionals. The tutors are always ready to help students, both in their studies and in practice. I discovered ThinkDog and decided to complete my training with the excellence the Italian market has to offer. I can only recommend ThinkDog as an all-round academic center of excellence.

Melegnano; a wonderful experience. The in-person meetings allowed us to form close friendships; a year later, we still speak almost daily. Not to mention the teachers, who always make you feel at ease and are available to answer any questions, even outside of class, for example, at the table or during breaks. It's not a walk in the park, but I can assure you it has helped me hone some of my positive character traits. Blessed be the day I signed up; it was certainly a sacrifice. It wasn't a walk in the park, but it was worth it, and I can only recommend myself to everyone. THANK YOU

Thank goodness I met ThinkDog! My life and mindset have completely changed, improved; now I feel I have a profound understanding of dogs. It's a fascinating world; those who don't know it won't reap its benefits.

Thinkdog changes your life...and that's not just a saying.

Highly recommended school, both from an educational standpoint (highly qualified teachers with many years of experience in the dog field) and from a human perspective (inclusion, empathy, support, and great availability from the staff and classmates are some of the defining features).
The courses are certainly expensive, but the quality of what's offered is worth it.
Last but not least, the opportunity to create lasting friendships, something that's not so easy to come by these days.

I'm a dog trainer and behavioral rehabilitation technician with Opes Cinofilia-Coni, but to gain deeper training, knowledge, and life experience, I decided to continue my journey at ThinkDog... no choice has been more fitting, closer, and in tune with my journey.
At ThinkDog, I earned my certification as a dog trainer in behavioral rehabilitation and socialization classes, and it was a unique experience from both an educational and human perspective. The non-judgmental approach, collaboration, and support from tutors, teachers, and colleagues were fundamental.

A journey that changed my life!
A great journey that led me to deeply understand my dogs.
As a professional, I try to help humans and dogs connect and share their lives in the best possible way.

I'm taking the Educator course and I'm very satisfied. I find the instructors very knowledgeable and helpful, and the content extremely interesting. I've found the entire staff, tutors, and assistants to be very cooperative. It's a comprehensive learning experience, a journey of growth not only from a dog-training perspective but also, and above all, from a human perspective. Thank you, TD!
Hi, I'm Francesca and I'm attending the dog trainer course and I'm doing well, I've improved my relationship with Nina and I'm building a relationship with Hugo

It all started when I was completely new to the world of dog training.
When Ombra entered our life, I felt a strong need to do well, to seek the best for her and for us.
I wanted a guide, a point of reference to grow with her in the most conscious and respectful way possible.

And so I met ThinkDog.
A place made up of people who put the dog, the relationship, and listening at the center.
A place that taught me to see Ombra for who she truly was, and not for what I wanted her to be.

In 2023, Ombra flew across the bridge… wise, evolved, and deeply loved.
And I owe much of what we were able to build together to the training I received at this school.
A journey I carry in my heart, with infinite gratitude.

I first came across think dog as the "owner" of two dogs. I was tired of not understanding them as I would have liked, but something was missing...
I found so much material on Angelo Vaira's blog that made me realize I was on the right path, and so I signed up for the actual course, after a phone interview with the director of teaching. Then there was the
Puppies Course... and I passed it (2017).
And, not content, I also signed up for the educators' course.
And now, the master's degree in reactivity.
What can I say? I found professionalism, a listening ear, I felt at home, and my difficulties were a point of strength, of growth.
My relationship with my dogs has changed radically, but not only that!!! I've changed, above all.
I recommend the school with all my heart.

I'm a Veterinarian with a Behavioral Expertise and have been working for years with instructors trained at this school to help dogs with behavioral problems. I've been so impressed with the training that I decided to take the instructor course as a refresher. Empathy, courtesy, and respect are the hallmarks of these instructors, in addition to the necessary professional skills that are essential for successful rehabilitation.

I took the Think Dog trainer course almost out of curiosity, driven by the behavior of my dog ​​Antea. I found myself enjoying a highly formative, collaborative experience with highly trained teachers and qualified staff. I've thus pushed myself further, becoming a social skills instructor and behavioral trainer in training. I would always do it all again with Think Dog.

The experience with Thinkdog was and still is a truly amazing discovery. It's not just a school where I attended a dog training course, but a lifestyle. The assistants, tutors, and teachers made the knowledge and practice interesting and accessible to everyone. I highly recommend anyone looking for a dog trainer/instructor, as well as anyone looking to start a training program, to follow their social media pages for helpful tips.

From the educator course to the instructor course, it's been a fantastic journey filled with up-to-date learning and wonderful moments of sharing with classmates, a positive energy that helps you grow professionally and personally! Simply thank you 🙏 …

ThinkDog changed my life with Chanty, a 10-year-old dog I trained with Angelo Vaira's methods, which I learned during my dog ​​training course. I learned to understand Chanty, to help her in times of difficulty, and to develop a bond of understanding and collaboration with her that I've never had with any other dog before. At the school, I met extremely qualified, knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful people—a true family who works hard to train new cognitive-relational trainers, always with a smile and the utmost professionalism. Thank you so much ❤️

The school is truly well-organized and effective. I've already worked as a dog trainer for years, both privately and in Rome's municipal kennels. I chose them to update my skills after 3 years of little work due to the birth of my second child. To be honest, I contacted them with the doubt that "if they are so good at making themselves known to humans, will they really be good at interacting with dogs?". Furthermore, having already studied in the past and with a fair amount of experience under my belt, I wondered if their courses were right for me. I was guided from the start to fit in at the right level. This allowed me not to waste time and money following subjects I already mastered but to study with them everything I really needed (not everything, you never stop learning, even from the dogs themselves). The ability of the teaching manager to frame my situation proved to be perfect. While taking the course, I was amazed at how well the choice of what to propose me to do and what not to had been spot on. Then, once the course began, from my first module and the first teacher I met (Luigi Di Leo), I realized that my fears were unfounded: the depth of the teachers was evident from Immediately.
The atmosphere among everyone, teachers and students, made me feel young again.
Eight years have passed since that first phone call requesting information, and I still participate in the school's initiatives as often as possible with great enthusiasm. To top it all off, I've met many wonderful people, some of whom have become important friends in my life.
Truly a top-notch school...the commitment of the entire staff manages to instill in you the passion that makes you fall in love with this job! A perspective that opens up the world to you!

Think Dog isn't just a place where you learn, it's about unity, sharing, teamwork, and above all, love. It's something that changes you from the inside out. I'm on the dog trainer program, and my life is changing because it's by meeting people like Angelo Vaira, Marina Balbi, Laura Calvelli, and Luigi Di Leo, just to name a few, that the journey becomes something incredible and surprising beyond all expectations!

Thinkdog is a 360-degree school, where you truly learn who your dog is and the best way to connect with them. All the teachers are top-notch and have a common goal that transcends any dogma and highlights the true essence of the relationship. I've grown not only professionally but above all personally, which is crucial to doing this job, and ThinkDog does just that. It doesn't just teach you how to do things, but above all how to be, and I believe this is the key to being able to help and become part of a care system. If I may, I would recommend everyone to join Thinkdog ☺️
ThinkDog is training, knowledge, empathy, and so much more... being part of the school is a generative experience!!! Thank you always!

ThinkDog is the future of dog training!
Angelo Vaira and his extraordinary team are carrying out valuable work: making the cognitive-relational approach accessible and understandable to everyone. With passion, expertise, and a healthy dose of humanity, they help build an authentic relationship between dog and human. It's not just education, it's cultural evolution... with a wagging tail!

If you're looking for a dog training school where ethical values, professionalism, hospitality, respect, and passion go hand in hand, with passion and the joy of being together, ThinkDog is the ideal choice for you and your dogs!!!

I believe ThinkDog is one of the very few dog training schools where ethics and respect for people exist.
The quality of the training courses is very high, and the teaching is updated year after year, boasting a faculty that is unique in this sector!
The profession of trainer/instructor isn't for everyone; you need a natural talent, but the school provides a wealth of theoretical and practical knowledge to become highly qualified.
The tutors are wonderful and truly guide you step by step. I personally began training at this school in 2019 and was able to experience the challenges of COVID alongside them, to which the organization responded admirably by managing NOT to suspend training.
Respect, listening, ethics, and precision are qualities you find (and earn) when you enter this environment, which—fortunately—is still a healthy part of the dog training world.
If there are any problems, no matter how serious or significant, Angelo and Manú are always available to provide support and find a solution, for the individual or the group.

And when you step away from the role of student and teacher, you discover truly remarkable people and classmates who remain friends for a long, long time.

Even today, when I serve as a TD course assistant, I take a breath of fresh air that warms my heart ♥️

Very humane people, comprehensive and unique training. I decided to embark on the program with thinkdog because I want to help dogs live full, emotionally enriching lives and help build a relationship of trust and understanding with their human companions. The school is highly skilled in this field, and the teachers are very humane, which is essential for this course, in my opinion. I recommend it to anyone who wants to treat their dog with respect and sincere love.

A place where you can not only continue to learn through continuous training, but also create synergies and collaborations with a view to shared growth aimed at the well-being of the dog and its family.

When I decided to embark on the path to becoming a dog trainer, I had no doubts about which school to choose. Today, nine months after beginning this wonderful journey, I can only confirm my convictions.

This isn't simply a school that teaches you to become a dog trainer: it's a school that teaches you the profound meaning of life, respect, and empathy for all living things.

The school environment is that of a large family, where we support each other and are constantly encouraged to give our best. The preparation and professionalism of the teachers and staff are qualities I deeply admire, and they motivate me every day to want to learn more, with the goal of one day becoming like them.

Attend this school if you're tired of the superficiality of today's world and want to rediscover the true meaning of the words "love" and "happiness."

I joined the Thinkdog family in 2017, and since then the school has supported my growth, not only in my dog ​​training. It has taught me to deeply understand not only dogs but also the humans around me. A school that never stops, evolves, and engages you. It doesn't isolate you, but integrates and listens. Thanks to all the staff, but also to all the people I've met and who have supported me throughout my studies. This is also what the Thinkdog school is... we are also the Thinkdog school...

I approached the Think Dog school because I was interested in the master's degree in aggression, and I found it so valuable that I also decided to take the instructor course in sociability and freedom. I find the program wonderful; it opens your mind to a new dog training approach that is respectful and rewarding for instructors and clients, and especially for the dogs themselves, who deserve to be understood in all their wonderful essence.
Recommended school! ❤️

I attended the Thinkdog training course and can highly recommend it to anyone who wants to deepen their relationship with their dog in a thoughtful and respectful manner. The instructors are extremely competent, passionate, and always up-to-date on the latest training methods. Each lesson is an opportunity to learn something new, both technically and interpersonally.

Great credit also goes to the tutors and assistants, who are always kind, available, and ready to help at any time, with an empathetic approach to both humans and dogs. The environment is welcoming, inclusive, and stimulating, where learning takes place in a climate of positive discussion and mutual growth.

A truly valuable educational and personal experience. Thank you, Thinkdog!

I attended the Educators course between September 2020 and September 2021, taking the exam in February 2022.
It wasn't the best time to attend such a course because the COVID-19 pandemic prevented in-person classes from always being possible. There were months when a Prime Ministerial Decree came into force on Friday evenings, and in-person classes on Saturdays and Sundays were canceled. The school's organization and the teachers' professionalism allowed us to catch up on all our work while we were still scheduled. Our tutor was always available for clarification, as were all the teachers through dedicated online groups on Facebook and WhatsApp.
Personally, I've always felt supported in my educational and career journey. There are additional services the school offers to support starting your own business; these are paid services, as is only right when you're benefiting from someone else's time, IT systems, and experience. There are no mandatory costs, and transparency regarding fees and payment methods is rare. This doesn't mean a course defines a professional; after the exam, you have to start getting your hands dirty with the tools the school provides during the training, which allow you to initially work within your comfort zone without harming your dogs or yourself.
Even during my course, there was a mention of a food brand recommended by the school. Personally, I saw it as a plus, not a cash-generating sponsorship. In my case, it was also a lifesaver because after trying that brand, my dog ​​was literally reborn.
Sometimes, you just have to force yourself to broaden your horizons and avoid seeing the hidden flaws in even the best intentions. I've been attending the Master's in Reactivity for a few months now, and I particularly appreciate its focus on going beyond merely offering advice on correcting dogs, but rather exploring the concept of reactivity, a much broader topic that concerns not only our dogs but also, and especially, us humans.
There are other highly esteemed schools in Italy, but with different approaches. It's up to each of us to decide which one best fits our needs and our own training requirements. It's essential to educate ourselves before enrolling, even by chatting with the administration.

I enrolled in the Thinkdog Educator course in 2020, the year of the pandemic, and my course was the first time I tried the blended methodology, both online and in person, and I must say it worked great. It was a unique experience that changed my life, or rather, changed my way of seeing and approaching life. The teachers, tutors, and staff were competent and always very helpful. It felt like family, supported and supported through every step, even the most difficult ones. Many practical activities challenge you, not only with your own dog but also with the dogs of others. Thank you so much to Thinkdog for accepting my application and allowing me to make this transformation, to meet fantastic people, to better understand my four-legged companion and all the others who still need to be better understood by their human companions.

I've been in this extraordinary school for two years. The Behavioral Rehabilitation Training Course and the Social and Freedom Instructor Course are what I love most and have been looking forward to for a long time, the reason I approached this school.
A professionally-focused school and a family that welcomes without judgment, even those who, like me, come from other schools and have some regrets about not having found it sooner, when I was younger and more energetic :-). A school that gives so much and demands so much: commitment, effort, hours of study and hours of practice: each path is dictated by a path that can be continuously enriched at personal discretion; it is the individual who makes the difference on an already perfect path. Curiosity is the foundation of knowledge, and knowledge becomes the foundation of skills. Every certificate you earn is a small piece of a larger puzzle, and you should never feel like you've arrived, EVER. Every in-depth book and every course or Master's program offered will bear witness to this. Impeccable organization with dedicated teachers, tutors, assistants, secretarial staff, and IT experts who have an answer for every question; the cost is totally justified by the enormous commitment and work behind it, and why shouldn't there be a profit? I attended the ThinkDog dog trainer course two years ago and, unfortunately, my experience was not positive.

The main problem is the drastic lack of practical hours: the training is heavily weighted toward theory, while the space for developing practical skills is extremely limited. This makes it very difficult, if not impossible, to feel prepared to actually work with dogs once the course is completed.
Furthermore, the few practical activities included are always done in groups, which further limits their effectiveness: not everyone has the opportunity to work with their own dog, and often, direct experience is limited to just a few minutes. The school still requires individual lessons with a TD educator, specifically to enhance practical work, and the cost is not included in the package (about €250).
Considering the significant cost of the course (about €4,000), I expected more robust training tools.

Another incident that I found profoundly inappropriate occurred during online lessons: I and other students were contacted privately in the Zoom course chat by a ThinkDog employee to promote a dog food brand. I find this behavior unprofessional and out of context, considering it was a training course and not a commercial platform. The combination of training and sales is, in my opinion, completely inappropriate.

Finally, I must mention an unpleasant experience related to the Think Dog Community on Facebook. After expressing a polite but critical opinion in response to a user asking for honest feedback on the course, I was banned from the group. This behavior I find hypocritical, given that the school claims to promote inclusion, sharing, and discussion.

In conclusion, I wouldn't recommend this course to anyone seeking comprehensive and truly professional training. I hope ThinkDog can reconsider its approach and embrace discussion, rather than silencing critical voices, especially since they can't be removed here on Google.
